confirmation.heading: Got it — your request is in
confirmation.body: Thank you for the details. Someone from the team reads them and comes back to you by email — with a few time slots if your case needs a call, or straight with what you asked for if it doesn't.

howToPrepare.heading: If your request is about studying abroad, it helps to have on hand
items: Your target course, university, or field of study — even if it's not final yet
Your intended start date or academic year
Any documents you've already gathered (previous diplomas, transcripts)
Any questions you want a direct answer to
